entries.jp: おまえは！？{n}・・・なぜここにいる？{page}この世界にはいってくる{n}デビルがいたとはな。{page}まあよい。ちょうど{n}たいくつしていたところだ。{page}ジャマをしないよう、{n}ここでしまつしてやろう！
entries.en: You!? ...Why are you here?{page}I never imagined a demon{n}would get into this world.{page}No matter. I was just getting bored.{page}I'll dispose of you here{n}so you can't interfere!
entries.src: You!? ...Why are you here? // I never imagined a demon would get into this world. // No matter. I was just getting bored. // I'll dispose of you here so you can't interfere!

entries.jp: ほほう。{n}泉の方から来たということは、{page}キミがクロセルを{n}たおしたというのですか？{page}クロセルもだらしないですね。{n}コドモにやられるとは。{page}このワタシはちがいます。{n}アイテになりましょう！
entries.en: Oho.{page}Since you came from the{n}direction of the spring,{page}am I to understand that{n}you defeated Crosel?{page}How pathetic of Crosel, losing to a child.{page}I am different. I shall be your opponent!
entries.src: Oho. // Since you came from the direction of the spring, // am I to understand that you defeated Crosel? // How pathetic of Crosel, losing to a child. // I am different. I shall be your opponent!

entries.jp: ホホホ・・・{n}ごくろうさまです。{page}やっとちょうじょうまで{n}来たところですが、{page}ワタシとたたかって{n}もらいますよ。{page}この世界のことを{n}知ったからには、{page}だっしゅつはさせません。
entries.en: Ho ho ho... Thank you for your trouble.{page}You've only just made it to the summit,{page}but I'm afraid you'll have to fight me.{page}Now that you know about this world,{page}I won't let you escape.
entries.src: Ho ho ho... Thank you for your trouble. // You've only just made it to the summit, // but I'm afraid you'll have to fight me. // Now that you know about this world, // I won't let you escape.

entries.jp: やはり来たか。{n}まっていたぞ。{page}われわれのケイカクは{n}じゅんちょうにすすんでいるが、{page}おまえたちをほうっておくと{n}ジャマをするかもしれない。{page}あのおかたじきじきの{n}ごめいれいだ。{page}ジゴクのごうかで{n}しまつしてやる。
entries.en: So you came after all. I've been waiting.{page}Our plan proceeds smoothly,{page}but if we leave you be,{n}you may get in our way.{page}These are orders from my lord himself.{page}I'll dispose of you in the flames of hell!
entries.src: So you came after all. I've been waiting. // Our plan proceeds smoothly, // but if we leave you be, you may get in our way. // These are orders from my lord himself. // I'll dispose of you in the flames of hell!

entries.jp: ずいぶんなかつやくだな。{page}ミゴトといいたいところだが、{n}ここをとおして{page}あのおかたの手を{n}わずらわせるわけにはいかん。{page}このビフロンスがキサマらの{n}ボウケンをおわらせてやろう！
entries.en: Quite the show you've been putting on.{page}I'd like to call it splendid,{n}but I can't let you pass{page}and trouble my lord with you.{page}I, Bifronz, shall put an end to{n}your adventure, you wretches!
entries.src: Quite the show you've been putting on. // I'd like to call it splendid, but I can't let you pass // and trouble my lord with you. // I, Bifronz, shall put an end to your adventure, you wretches!

entries.jp: しょせんおまえたちには{n}われわれの考えがわかるまい。{page}まだるっこしい話など{n}するひつようもない！{page}さあ、けっちゃくを{n}つけようではないか！
entries.en: You could never understand{n}our ideals anyway.{page}There's no need for tedious talk!{page}Now, let us settle this!
entries.src: You could never understand our ideals anyway. // There's no need for tedious talk! // Now, let us settle this!

entries.jp: フハハハハ！{n}こいつはめずらしいな。{page}この世界にがいぶからの{n}しんにゅうしゃだと？{page}おもしろくなりそうだ。{page}おまえをつれかえって{n}しらべてやろう。{page}そのまえに・・・{n}かくごはいいかな？
entries.en: Fwahahaha! Now this is a rare sight.{page}An intruder from outside this world?{page}This should be fun.{page}I'll take you back with me and study you.{page}But first... are you prepared?
entries.src: Fwahahaha! Now this is a rare sight. // An intruder from outside this world? // This should be fun. // I'll take you back with me and study you. // But first... are you prepared?

entries.jp: まよってここに{n}来てしまったのか？{page}いや、そんなはずはない。{n}そうなると・・・{page}キサマはこの世界のちつじょを{n}みだすそんざいということだ。{page}そのようなそんざいを、{n}見のがすわけにはいかん。{page}だいじになるまえに、{n}そのめをつんでやろう。
entries.en: Did you lose your way{n}and wander in here?{page}No, that can't be. Which means...{page}you are a being that disrupts the{n}order of this world, you wretch.{page}Such a being cannot be overlooked.{page}I'll nip you in the bud{n}before this gets serious.
entries.src: Did you lose your way and wander in here? // No, that can't be. Which means... // you are a being that disrupts the order of this world, you wretch. // Such a being cannot be overlooked. // I'll nip you in the bud before this gets serious.

entries.jp: デビルチルドレン。{page}キミとこのようなカタチで{n}あうのはとてもざんねんだ。{page}キミのしていることに{n}あのおかたはおいかりで、{page}キミをつかまえよとの{n}ごめいれいがあったのだ。{page}せめて、魔力だけは{n}ゆうこうにかつようするよ。{page}ん？ジャマがはいったか。{n}先にかたづけてくれよう。
entries.en: DemiKid.{page}It's a great shame to meet you like this.{page}My lord is angered by{n}what you've been doing,{page}and has ordered your capture.{page}At the very least, I'll put{n}your magic to good use.{page}Hm? An interruption?{n}I'll deal with this first.
entries.src: DemiKid. // It's a great shame to meet you like this. // My lord is angered by what you've been doing, // and has ordered your capture. // At the very least, I'll put your magic to good use. // Hm? An interruption? I'll deal with this first.

entries.jp: じゅんちょうに魔力は{n}たまっているというのに、{page}おまえたちは、われわれの{n}ケイカクをとめにきたのか？{page}われわれのケイカクが{n}ほんかくてきにうごきだせば、{page}ヴァルハラはまさに{n}りそうきょうになる。{page}あのおかたいがいに、{n}だれがじつげんできよう。{page}ワタシはどこまでも{n}ついていくぞ！！
entries.en: Our magic accumulates smoothly,{page}and yet you've come to stop our plan?{page}Once our plan is fully underway,{page}Valhalla will become a true paradise.{page}Who but my lord could make that real?{page}I will follow him to the very end!!
entries.src: Our magic accumulates smoothly, // and yet you've come to stop our plan? // Once our plan is fully underway, // Valhalla will become a true paradise. // Who but my lord could make that real? // I will follow him to the very end!!

entries.jp: あなたたちは{n}知りすぎてしまったのです。{page}なにも知らなければ{n}コウフクでいられたのに。{page}もうにがしはしないわ。{n}ここでラクにしてあげる。
entries.en: You have learned too much.{page}Had you known nothing, you{n}could have stayed happy.{page}I won't let you escape now. I'll put{n}you out of your misery right here.
entries.src: You have learned too much. // Had you known nothing, you could have stayed happy. // I won't let you escape now. I'll put you out of your misery right here.

entries.jp: おまえたちのはたらきは{n}しょうさんにあたいする。{page}だが、しょせんは{n}わかりあえないそんざいだ。{page}話すことなど{n}イミをなさない。{page}さあ、けっちゃくを{n}つけようではないか！
entries.en: Your efforts are worthy of praise.{page}But in the end, we are beings who{n}can never understand each other.{page}Words are meaningless.{page}Now, let us settle this!
entries.src: Your efforts are worthy of praise. // But in the end, we are beings who can never understand each other. // Words are meaningless. // Now, let us settle this!
